name: Roop Kumar Rathod
description: '''Roopkumar Rathod''' is an Indian playback singer, pop singer, and music composer. He has performed a number of songs in [[Hindi]], [[Gujarati language|Gujarati]], [[Marathi language|Marathi]], [[Tamil language|Tamil]], [[Telugu language|Telugu]], [[Bengali language|Bengali]], [[Assamese language|Assamese]], [[Odia language|Odia]], [[Nepali language|Nepali]], [[Bhojpuri language|Bhojpuri]] and [[Kannada]] films.
